headline: Movement, Breath, and Connection Have Made a Profound Difference in Our Lives. We Hope They Do the Same for You.
story_paragraph: Ripples of Healing was founded by Anna Fernandez after her own journey healing chronic pain from scoliosis through yoga. What began as a personal practice became a passion — and then a calling to share these tools with the world.
charity_tagline: At Ripples of Healing, every membership creates waves of change. Together we support our most vulnerable — at-risk women and children. Your Ripples of Healing spread outward into the world.
